predict.question: A record starts empty. Three entries arrive per round; none are lost. After three rounds, entries retained?

exploreHint: Compare both named cases; keep each result for the reveal.
bookIdea: The Extended Mind examines how resources outside the brain can support thinking.
modelBoundary: The scratch list retains {A}; the persistent record {B}. Removing the stipulated losses preserves all incoming entries.
doesItHoldUp: Does it hold up? Human forgetting has no fixed loss rate, and external records can also fail.
